About me

I’m a first-year student at IIIT Nagpur, studying Electronics and Communication (IoT). I enjoy building real hardware with Arduino C and ESP boards, and I’d rather build a thing than read about it. My interests are embedded systems, electronics, programming, automation and cybersecurity.
